Optical Systems Lab

Brain-CT-Seg: AI for Mayo-Grade Brain Tumor Segmentation

Overcoming Machine, Deep Learning, and Clinical Radiologist Barriers in Non-Contrast CT

Machine / Acquisition

  • The rotation & head tilt problem
  • Sparse 5mm slice thickness & couch gaps
  • Cross-vendor variability (GE, Siemens, Philips)

Software / Deep Learning

  • Failure of standard CNNs on rotated scans
  • Severe 12–18% Dice drop under domain shift
  • Overconfident false positive tumor predictions

Medical Doctor / Radiologist

  • Subjectivity of human boundary delineation
  • High inter-observer variance (Dice 65–75%)
  • Subtle tumor contrast on Non-Contrast CT
Mod-Seg-SE(2) Consensus Platform
Equivariant Group Theory Backbone (N=8 discrete rotations) + 6-Model Consensus Heatmap Engine
Solves rotational invariance at the mathematical group level • Eliminates radiologist inter-observer variability • Quantifies 3D multi-slice tumor volume
84.2% Dice | 73.1% IoU SOTA Segmentation & Quantitative 3D Volumetry
